title: Denominator ideals of regular meromorphic sections have nowhere-dense cokernels
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $\mathcal L$ an invertible $\mathcal O_X$-module [def-sc-invertible-module]. Write $K_X$ for the sheaf of meromorphic functions (the sheafification of $U\mapsto\mathcal S(U)^{-1}\mathcal O_X(U)$, $\mathcal S(U)$ the sections whose stalks are non-zero-divisors at every point of $U$) and $K_X(\mathcal L):=K_X\otimes_{\mathcal O_X}\mathcal L$, which contains $\mathcal L$. Let $s\in\Gamma(X,K_X(\mathcal L))$ be a regular meromorphic section, i.e. the map $K_X\to K_X(\mathcal L)$, $1\mapsto s$, is injective, and let $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ be the subsheaf with $\mathcal I(V)=\{f\in\mathcal O_X(V)\mid fs\in\mathcal L(V)\}$. Then: (1) every point of $X$ has an affine open neighbourhood $U=\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ with a trivialization $\mathcal L|_U\cong\mathcal O_U$ under which $s|_U$ is the image of $a/b$ with $a,b\in A$ both non-zero-divisors of $A$, and $\mathcal I(U)=\{x\in A\mid x(a/b)\in A\}$ (computed in the total ring of fractions of $A$); (2) $\mathcal I$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals; (3) the maps $1:\mathcal I\to\mathcal O_X$ and $s:\mathcal I\to\mathcal L$ are injective, and their cokernels $\mathcal O_X/\mathcal I$ and $\mathcal L/s(\mathcal I)$ are supported on closed nowhere-dense subsets of $X$.
